title.en: Waste workers help winner find binned €1m lottery ticket in Italy
title.zh: 意大利垃圾处理工人帮助中奖者找回被扔掉的百万欧元彩票

summary.en: Waste workers in Italy helped a lottery winner recover a €1 million ticket he had accidentally thrown away. The man realized his mistake after his family informed him that his long-played numbers had been drawn.
summary.zh: 意大利的垃圾处理工人帮助一位彩票中奖者找回了他不慎扔掉的100万欧元彩票。这名男子在家人告知他多年来购买的号码中奖后，才意识到自己犯了错误。

body.en:
A lottery player who accidentally binned a €1m (£857,158) winning-ticket may be the luckiest man in Italy after refuse workers found the missing slip.

The anonymous player disposed of the ticket in a shop in Bitonto, southern Italy, after checking his numbers and being told it was "non-payable".

The man only realised he threw away a winning ticket after a relative pointed out the numbers he always played had been drawn.

It sparked a two-day search through a "mountain of waste" which had been collected by a bin lorry, the head of the refuse company, Roberto Nicola Toscano, told Italian news agency Ansa.

Recounting the story, he said the mix-up happened because the "non-payable" message appears when the prize is too high to be paid out by the shop.

When the player returned home, his family reportedly pointed out his favourite numbers - 2, 4, 8, 10, and 51 - had been drawn.

"It was then that he realised the misunderstanding. So they all went to the shop together and discovered that the tickets had been thrown away and collected by one our operators," said Toscano, director of SANB who handles waste collection in the area.

After the player made contact with the refuse company, the bin lorry was located before its contents were compacted for disposal.

"Luckily it was a Sunday, otherwise the load would have already ended up in landfill," the boss told Italian broadcaster TGCOM24.

The truck was then escorted to a special site where the search began to find the "small piece of paper hidden in a mountain of waste".

Finally after a two-day search, the winning ticket was reportedly found by a waste worker on Tuesday morning.

"It was in a hole-ridden bag along with other damaged tickets: this was one of the few intact ones," Toscano told Ansa.

The cost of the recovery operation is set to be charged to the winner, who had previously signed a declaration promising to cover the costs associated with the search.

The luck even rubbed off when Toscano and his colleagues brought a scratch card as a joke. They won €50 (£43).
body.zh: 一名彩票玩家不小心将一张 100 万欧元（857,158 英镑）的中奖彩票扔进了垃圾桶，垃圾处理工人发现了丢失的单据，他可能是意大利最幸运的人。 这位匿名玩家在检查了自己的号码并被告知“不可支付”后，在意大利南部比通托的一家商店里处理了这张彩票。 当一位亲戚指出他一直玩的号码已经被抽出后，这名男子才意识到自己扔掉了一张中奖彩票。 垃圾公司负责人罗伯托·尼古拉·托斯卡诺告诉意大利安莎通讯社，这引发了对一辆垃圾车收集的“垃圾山”的为期两天的搜索。 在讲述这个故事时，他说，之所以发生这种混乱，是因为当奖金太高而商店无法支付时，就会出现“不可支付”的信息。 据报道，当这位球员回到家时，他的家人指出他最喜欢的号码——2、4、8、10和51——已经被抽中了。 “就在那时，他意识到了误会。于是他们一起去了商店，发现票被扔掉了，并被我们的一位经营者收集起来，”负责该地区垃圾收集的 SANB 主任托斯卡诺说。 玩家与垃圾公司联系后，在垃圾车内的物品被压实处置之前找到了垃圾车的位置。 老板告诉意大利广播公司TGCOM24：“幸运的是，那天是周日，否则这些货物早就被扔进垃圾填埋场了。” 随后卡车被护送到一个特殊地点，在那里开始寻找“隐藏在垃圾山中的小纸片”。 经过两天的搜寻，最终，据报道，周二早上，一名垃圾处理工人发现了中奖彩票。 托斯卡诺告诉安莎社：“它和其他损坏的门票一起装在一个破洞的袋子里：这是为数不多的完好无损的门票之一。” 恢复操作的费用将由获胜者承担，获胜者此前签署了一份声明，承诺支付与搜索相关的费用。 当托斯卡诺和他的同事开玩笑地带来一张刮刮卡时，运气甚至消失了。他们赢得了 50 欧元（43 英镑）。

reflection.en: This remarkable story of a lost and found fortune reminds us that all ability to gain wealth ultimately comes from Yahweh. While a lottery win feels like pure chance, it can prompt us to reflect on the source of all good things. May this unexpected blessing be received with gratitude and a recognition of divine provision.
reflection.zh: 这个失而复得的财富故事提醒我们，所有获取财富的能力最终都来自雅伟。虽然彩票中奖看似纯属偶然，但它能促使我们思考万物美善的源头。愿这份意外的祝福被感恩地接受，并认识到雅伟的供应。

verse.textEn: Remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.
verse.textZh: 你要记念雅伟你的神，因为得货财的力量是他给你的。

title.en: Russia strike kills 21 as Ukraine says it needs more missile interceptors
title.zh: 官员称俄罗斯弹道导弹袭击基辅造成14人死亡22人受伤

summary.en: Officials report that a Russian ballistic missile strike on Kyiv has killed 14 people and injured 22. The head of Kyiv's military administration stated that the region around the city is "once again massively attacking."
summary.zh: 官员报告称，俄罗斯对基辅的一次弹道导弹袭击造成14人死亡，22人受伤。基辅军事管理局负责人表示，该市周边地区“再次遭到大规模袭击”。

body.en:
Russia has attacked Ukraine with ballistic missiles and drones, killing at least 21 people, as Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky said interceptors "could have saved lives".

Kyiv and the surrounding region experienced the deadliest strikes it had seen this year overnight, with 17 people reported dead. Attacks in Kharkiv and Donetsk also killed one and three people respectively.

Ukraine, who has consistently urged allies for more US-made Patriot missile interceptors to defend against Russian ballistics, has not reported intercepting any of the missiles in the overnight attack.

Zelensky added delays in receiving anti-ballistic systems from partners leads to "horrific casualties and destruction".

The president later said the supply of interceptors from allies had been "significantly reduced" this year.

The Russia defence ministry said it had struck logistics hubs and supply centres in Kyiv and the surrounding region.

"These centres were involved in the storage, delivery of various weapons and military supplies, as well as in the production and distribution of unmanned aerial vehicles," it said.

It also said it had hit three cargo vessels "which were transporting weapons and military equipment" near the Black Sea port of Odesa.

Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said there were fears people could be trapped under rubble, after residential buildings, a railway station and warehouses were hit.

Ukraine's emergency services said one person had died in the city of Kyiv and at least 16 injured, with a further 16 dead and 29 injured in the wider region.

Meanwhile, one person had died and several were injured - including one who was in a critical condition - from Russian shelling in Kharkiv, the regional head Oleh Syniehubov said.

Three people were also killed in Donetsk and 27 injured, the governor Vadym Filashkin said.

Fires were still being extinguished in five locations across the Kyiv region on Wednesday, covering an area of approximately 230,000 sq m, it added.

The country's air force said in a post on Telegram that Russia had launched 24 ballistic missiles and four anti-ship missiles during the attack on the capital.

It added that 115 drones had been launched by Russia during last night's attack and air defence systems intercepted 98 of them.

Ukrainian air force data analysed by BBC Verify shows missile interceptions over the last month have fallen by 22% compared with the same period last year (44.4% in 2026, 66.7% in 2025).

Ukraine intercepted 156 of 351 Russian missiles launched between 6 July to 5 August in 2026 compared with 128 of 192 in 2025.

The data also represents an increase of Russian missile launches of 83% this month compared with last year.

body.zh: 俄罗斯用弹道导弹和无人机袭击了乌克兰，造成 14 人死亡，至少 22 人受伤，这是今年基辅各地最致命的袭击之一。 在周三午夜后开始的袭击中，基辅军事当局负责人蒂穆尔·特卡琴科表示，“敌人再次大规模袭击基辅地区”。 空袭警报持续了一个多小时，一波又一波的弹道导弹袭击了该市及其郊区。基辅军事当局表示，炮火袭击损坏了住宅楼和仓库。 特卡琴科说，鲍里斯波尔地区有 9 人死亡，布查地区有 4 人死亡，法斯蒂夫地区有 1 人死亡。 基辅市长维塔利·克里琴科表示，人们担心市中心遭受袭击后，人们可能被困在瓦砾下。 基辅军事当局表示：“敌人再次蓄意袭击平民和民用基础设施。” 俄罗斯近几周加大了对基辅的袭击力度，而乌克兰也加大了对包括电力设施在内的俄罗斯民用基础设施的袭击力度。 它还多次针对俄罗斯电子商务巨头Wildberry 的仓库。周二上午，莫斯科地区发生了最近一次针对 Wildberry 仓库的袭击，造成 5 人死亡、10 人受伤。 此前一天，俄罗斯官员称，克拉斯诺达尔地区南部一处繁忙的海滩发生无人机袭击事件，造成 7 人死亡、58 人受伤，游客在一旁观看。 与此同时，乌克兰对一段显示一名男子在赫尔松被无人机追赶的视频表示愤怒，称这是针对平民的蓄意“狩猎”和“狩猎”。 乌克兰敦促盟国购买更多美制爱国者导弹拦截器，以防御俄罗斯的弹道攻击。

reflection.en: In the face of repeated attacks and tragic loss of life, the human spirit can feel overwhelmed by sustained devastation. Yet, even amidst such profound suffering, the steadfast love and mercies of Yahweh are new every morning, offering a source of enduring hope and strength.
reflection.zh: 面对反复的袭击和生命的悲惨逝去，人的心灵会因持续的破坏而感到不堪重负。然而，即使在如此深重的苦难中，雅伟的坚定之爱和怜悯每天都是新的，为我们提供了持久的希望和力量。

verse.textEn: Because of Yahweh's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.
verse.textZh: 我们不至消灭，是出于雅伟诸般的慈爱；是因他的怜悯不至断绝。每早晨这都是新的。

title.en: Michigan Senate Democratic primary race remains too close to call as El-Sayed holds narrow lead – US politics live
title.zh: 密歇根州参议院民主党初选选情胶着，埃尔-萨耶德微弱领先

summary.en: The Democratic primary race for the Michigan Senate remains undecided, with former public health official El-Sayed holding a narrow lead over congresswoman Haley Stevens. Vote counting is expected to continue throughout the day, indicating a very close contest.

That will get going at 4:30pm ET, and we’ll bring you the latest. Continue reading...
body.zh: 这位前公共卫生官员稍稍领先于国会女议员海莉·史蒂文斯，但计票可能会持续到埃尔赛义德在密歇根州参议院初选中以微弱优势领先的那一天，但双方的竞选势均力敌。他不适合在国会任职。米勒于 2022 年在新泽西州贝德明斯特的特朗普俱乐部与艾米丽·莫雷诺结婚，她被指控用枪指着她的头，并用开水烫她。他们2023年出生的幼儿女儿据说也因他的行为而锁骨骨折。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As communities navigate close political races, the importance of wise leadership for the well-being of a people becomes clear. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that where there is no guidance, a people falls, but in an abundance of counselors there is safety. This highlights the collective need for discernment in choosing those who will lead and guide.
reflection.zh: 当社区面对胶着的政治竞选时，明智的领导对人民福祉的重要性就显而易见。箴言11:14提醒我们，没有引导，民就跌倒；谋士众多，人便安居。这强调了在选择领导和引导者时，集体需要有分辨力。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Middle East crisis live: US and Iran signal hope for Hormuz deal but terms unclear
title.zh: 中东危机实时报道：美国和伊朗就霍尔木兹协议发出希望信号，但条款不明

summary.en: US and Iranian officials have indicated hope for a deal concerning the Strait of Hormuz, though the specific terms remain unclear. Iran stated that ongoing talks with Oman would not lead to an immediate reopening, with one proposal suggesting Iran control the entry route and Oman the exit route for ships.
summary.zh: 美国和伊朗官员表示，对霍尔木兹海峡的协议抱有希望，尽管具体条款尚不明确。伊朗表示，与阿曼的持续谈判不会立即导致其重新开放，其中一项提议是伊朗控制船只进入海湾的航线，而阿曼负责离开的航线。

body.en: While Trump suggests deal could come as soon as today, Iran indicates that ongoing talks with Oman would not lead to its immediate reopening One idea being floated is for Iran to control the route for ships entering the Gulf, while Oman would be responsible for the exit route . The Associated Press spoke to two regional officials familiar with the Iran-Oman talks who said service fees would be charged for keeping ships safe and protecting the waters. Iran has repeatedly said the strait of Hormuz will not operate as it did before the war, as it seeks to secure a greater role in managing the critical shipping route. The Trump administration, however, has rejected any deal that would allow Iran such control. Continue reading...
body.zh: 尽管特朗普表示最早可能在今天达成协议，但伊朗表示，与阿曼正在进行的谈判不会导致其立即重新开放。目前提出的一个想法是，伊朗控制进入海湾的船只的航线，而阿曼将负责退出航线。美联社采访了两名熟悉伊朗-阿曼会谈的地区官员，他们表示将收取服务费，以确保船只安全和保护水域。伊朗一再表示，霍尔木兹海峡将不会像战前那样运作，因为它寻求在管理这条关键航线方面发挥更大作用。然而，特朗普政府拒绝了任何允许伊朗进行此类控制的协议。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The ongoing talks regarding the Strait of Hormuz, despite unclear terms, reflect the persistent human effort to find common ground and de-escalate tensions. Yahweh's word encourages us to pursue peace whenever possible, recognizing our role in fostering harmonious relations. Even when full agreement is elusive, the commitment to dialogue is a step towards...
reflection.zh: 关于霍尔木兹海峡的持续谈判，尽管条款尚不明确，却反映了人类寻求共同点和缓解紧张局势的持续努力。雅伟的话语鼓励我们，只要可能，就去追求和平，认识到我们在促进和谐关系中的作用。即使完全达成一致很困难，对话的承诺也是迈向与所有人和平共处的一步。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Germany investigates drone carrying ‘explosive device’ near Ukrainian plane at busy cargo airport – Europe live
title.zh: 德国调查繁忙货运机场乌克兰飞机附近携带“爆炸装置”的无人机——欧洲直播

summary.en: German authorities are investigating a drone carrying a suspected explosive device found near a Ukrainian plane at a busy cargo airport in Leipzig. State prosecutors, including units focused on extremism and terrorism prevention, have taken over the case. DHL Group CEO Tobias Meyer confirmed the company is also...
summary.zh: 德国当局正在调查在莱比锡一个繁忙的货运机场附近，一架乌克兰飞机旁发现的一架载有疑似爆炸装置的无人机。包括负责打击极端主义和预防恐怖主义的部门在内的州检察官已接手此案。敦豪集团首席执行官托比亚斯·迈耶证实，该公司也在审查这起夜间事件。

body.en: German state prosecutors including units working on extremism and terrorism prevention take over investigation into Leipzig incident For what it’s worth, DHL Group CEO Tobias Meyer said the German logistics firm was studying ​the overnight incident which also involved an object clashing with one of its planes near Leipzig. “We’ve ‌got plans for cases ​like this, and ​we’ll try to make sure that the influence on our customers will be as low as possible,” Meyer said during a quarterly results call earlier this morning, Reuters reported. Continue reading...
body.zh: 德国国家检察官，包括从事极端主义和预防恐怖主义工作的单位，接管了对莱比锡事件的调查。 DHL 集团首席执行官托拜厄斯·迈耶 (Tobias Meyer) 表示，无论其价值如何，这家德国物流公司正在研究这起夜间事件，该事件还涉及莱比锡附近与其一架飞机相撞的物体。据路透社报道，迈耶在今天上午早些时候的季度业绩电话会议上表示：“我们已经针对此类情况制定了计划，我们将尽力确保对客户的影响尽可能低。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: News of potential threats like an explosive device near an aircraft can naturally stir fear and uncertainty. In such moments, we are reminded that Yahweh promises His presence and strength, urging us not to be dismayed. Even amidst investigations into potential dangers, we can find reassurance in His unwavering support.
reflection.zh: 诸如飞机附近发现爆炸装置之类的潜在威胁新闻，自然会引起恐惧和不安。在这样的时刻，我们被提醒雅伟应许祂的同在和力量，敦促我们不要惊惶。即使在调查潜在危险之时，我们也能在祂坚定不移的支持中找到慰藉。

verse.textEn: So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God.
verse.textZh: 你不要害怕，因为我与你同在；不要惊惶，因为我是你的神。

title.en: Jewish leaders turn down meeting with Conservative council candidate jailed for antisemitism – UK politics live
title.zh: 司法大臣为提前释放警员安德鲁·哈珀的杀手进行辩护，可能面临法律挑战——英国政治直播

summary.en: The UK Justice Minister defended the early release of PC Andrew Harper's killers, acknowledging the family's profound grief while stating the government faces a difficult situation. This comes as ministers also plan to remove the requirement for companies to demonstrate green and progressive values for government...
summary.zh: 英国司法大臣为提前释放警员安德鲁·哈珀的杀手进行辩护，承认哈珀家人承受着难以想象的痛苦，但也表示政府面临“左右为难的境地”。与此同时，政府还将取消公司在获得政府合同前需证明其绿色和进步价值观的要求。

body.en: Board of Deputies of British Jews and the Jewish Leadership Council to meet with Tory party but decline meeting with Joshua Bonehill-Paine Badenoch defends decision to allow man jailed for antisemitism to stand as councillor Ministers will scrap the requirement for companies to prove their green and progressive values before they are awarded government contracts, and instead ask firms to prove they will help young people back into work. As part of a government push to reduce the number of people not in education, employment or training (Neets) in the UK and boost regional growth, public sector buyers will double the consideration they give to whether companies will get more people into jobs, rather than if they can show they are improving social and environmental wellbeing. Government procurement contracts account for about £90bn of taxpayers’ money spent each year. Continue reading...
body.zh: 杰克·理查兹承认哈珀家族遭受了“难以想象的痛苦”，但表示政府面临着“令人羡慕的境地”。部长们将取消企业在获得政府合同之前证明其绿色和进步价值观的要求，而是要求企业证明它们将帮助年轻人重返工作岗位。作为政府推动减少英国未接受教育、就业或培训的人数（Neets）并促进地区增长的一部分，公共部门买家将加倍考虑公司是否能让更多人找到工作，而不是是否能够证明他们正在改善社会和环境福祉。政府采购合同每年约占纳税人资金的 900 亿英镑。继续阅读...

reflection.en: When legal decisions bring immense pain to victims' families, it highlights the deep human longing for justice to be clear and unwavering. Habakkuk's lament reminds us that when the law seems paralyzed, the cry for true justice echoes profoundly. In such moments, we are called to pray for wisdom for leaders and comfort for those who grieve.
reflection.zh: 当法律判决给受害者家属带来巨大痛苦时，这凸显了人类对公正清晰、坚定不移的深切渴望。哈巴谷的哀叹提醒我们，当法律似乎瘫痪时，对真正公义的呼求会产生深刻的回响。在这样的时刻，我们蒙召为领袖的智慧和哀伤者的安慰祷告。

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

title.en: Head of drone manufacturer critically injured in car bomb in Russia
title.zh: 俄罗斯无人机制造商负责人遭遇汽车炸弹袭击，受重伤

summary.en: The head of a prominent Russian drone manufacturer was critically injured in a car bomb attack near Ekaterinburg, an incident believed to be an assassination attempt by Ukraine within Russian territory.

title.en: Record heatwave in South Korea as temperatures soar to 42.5C
title.zh: 韩国创纪录热浪 气温飙升至42.5摄氏度

summary.en: There have been at least 19 deaths related to the heatwave which has brought the country's hottest day since records began.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
South Korea is struggling against the effects of a blistering heatwave which has brought its highest ever temperatures.

A high of 42.5C was recorded on Sunday in the southern city of Yangsan, the country's highest temperature since modern record keeping began.

At least 19 people have died during the heatwave, according to authorities, and Seoul is under a severe heat warning for the first time under a system established this year by the government to respond to rising temperatures.

title.en: Hungary's Lake Velence is drying up
title.zh: 匈牙利韦伦采湖正在干涸

summary.en: Hungary is feeling the heat. The country's third-largest lake is shrinking, the Danube is running low, and soaring temperatures could force the country's only nuclear power plant to shut down.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Hungary is feeling the heat. The country's third-largest lake is shrinking, the Danube is running low, and soaring temperatures could force the country's only nuclear power plant to shut down.

A dead fish lies half-decayed on the shore. Its eyes have been picked out by the birds.

Hungary's  Lake Velence will likely experience a massive fish kill. That's because oxygen levels in the body of water are too low, according to environmental experts. This means more and more fish will suffocate.

Hungary has seen temperatures soar to 40 degrees Celsius, with barely any rain. This heat is having a major impact on the country's third-largest natural lake.

Its water has never been particularly deep, but the current situation is dire. Water levels have been recorded in Agard, on the southern shore, since 1933. It dropped to a historic low in September 2022, measuring just 53 centimeters. Yet as of today, August 4, the water level has dropped to a mere 29 centimeters (11 inches).

As long as it doesn't rain and temperatures remain hot, the water level will continue to drop every day, by half a centimeter per day on average. The water is currently evaporating at such a fast pace that there may soon be no continuous body of water left, only isolated pools. This could mark a critical tipping point for the lake.

The impact of Hungary's ongoing drought is already clearly visible. The lake has receded by dozens of meters. Ground once covered in water is now so dry that the soil is cracking. The reed belt surrounding the lake, which serves as a habitat for numerous bird species, is now largely rooted in dry soil.

But not all living creatures are suffering under the current conditions: that's evident from a constant hum in the air near the water's edge. As fish and aquatic plants find their habitats shrinking, flies, bacteria, and other decomposers take over, breaking down what the drought leaves behind.

The water shortage isn't just changing the lake — it's changing the entire region. Lake Velence is a popular tourist destination, located just 50 kilometers from Hungary's capital, Budapest. It is considered less crowded than nearby Lake Balaton.

But these days, there are barely any visitors. The remaining water has turned a brownish-green and taken on a slightly musty odor. A "No Swimming" sign has been put up, with yellow tape blocking access to the water. Five swimming spots have been closed to the public since July 23.

The Velence municipal government says the beach will only reopen once the lake's water quality improves, though it is unclear when that might happen. The persistent heat and low water levels mean the lake's water is getting warmer and warmer, leading to a growth in bacteria and blue-green algae.

title.en: Pakistan restricts international media reporting
title.zh: 巴基斯坦限制国际媒体报道

summary.en: Anyone working for foreign media, including Pakistanis, will now need permission to report from anywhere outside three major cities.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Pakistani authorities have imposed new restrictions on international media reporting in the country in a move that has drawn sharp criticism from journalist organisations.

Anyone working for foreign media, including Pakistani nationals, must now seek permission to report from anywhere except the cities of Islamabad, Karachi and Lahore.

The restrictions would leave on-the-ground reporting by foreign media at the discretion and timing of the authorities across most of Pakistan, which currently ranks 153 out of 180 on the World Press Freedom Index.

"These guidelines are tantamount to choking international media in an increasingly shrinking space," said political commentator Mustafa Nawaz Khokhar.

Limitations on the media are not new , but local media are often subject to more pressure than international outlets.

"The public looks at the international media for independent reporting," Khokhar says. "Placing restrictions simply creates more room for disinformation and spread of fake news."

Pakistan's government said the guidelines, issued on Sunday, are not to restrict media but to "provide an administrative mechanism" to verify media, facilitate access and co-ordinate reporting requirements.

The new rules - called the Foreign Media Facilitation Guidelines, 2026 - do not set out how long gaining permission, known as a No Objection Certificate or NOC, can take.

Foreign journalists already require NOCs and can wait months for permissions or never receive an answer - severely curtailing their ability to report breaking news stories from the ground in the country of 240 million people.

International media outlets often therefore rely on Pakistani nationals, who can travel more easily to – or are permanently based in – cities like Peshawar or Quetta, to verify information.

Under these new guidelines, any contributor, including freelancers, living outside the three specified cities would require NOC permissions to cover a story.

"These are ridiculous restrictions and are totally unacceptable," said Zaffar Abbas, editor of Dawn newspaper. "I have worked as a journalist in this country for over 40 years and have reported during the times of two military rulers and a number of autocratic civilian rules, but have never seen the imposition of such restrictions.

"To ask journalists to get an NOC for travelling outside the three major cities not just undermines freedom of movement but also freedom of the press."

The government says this is not a blanket restriction on the movement of individuals.

The guidelines also specify that journalists can lose their accreditation for "acts against ideology, sovereignty, security or public order of Pakistan". Khokhar describes this as "vague" and raises questions about how it might be interpreted.

title.en: Mexican influencer shot dead during livestream
title.zh: 墨西哥影响者在直播中被枪杀

summary.en: César Gastélum, who was known for comedy and lifestyle posts, was killed at close range by a man on a motorbike.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A Mexican influencer, César Gastélum, has been shot dead while livestreaming on TikTok.

Gastélum was filming with two friends outside a fast food restaurant in Tres Ríos, in the northern city of Culiacán, on Tuesday evening when when two men on a motorbike drove up to him and one shot him at close range.

He had more than half a million followers on TikTok and mainly uploaded comedy videos.

It is not the first time a social media influencer has been killed in Mexico. Last year, 23-year-old Valeria Márquez was shot dead at a beauty salon while she was livestreaming on TikTok.

On the livestream, Gastélum and his friends were wearing bright orange coats and bags typically used by delivery drivers.

Local media reported that their outfits originally led police to believe that the victim was a delivery driver, but officials were later alerted to his identity.

Police and forensic experts cordoned off the area and are examining the cartridge casings and CCTV footage for any clues.

No arrests have so far been made and the two people on the motorbike fled the scene.

On his Instagram account he often shared pictures of his travels and nights out, or posing in front of luxury cars.

In one of his posts, he could be seen at the grave of Leobardo Aispuro, an influencer known as "El Gordo Peruci".

Aispuro was shot dead in December 2024, in a killing which police said may have been linked to the rivalry between two warring factions of the Sinaloa cartel.

Violence in the state of Sinaloa, of which Culiacán is the capital, has spiralled since the two factions - Los Chapitos and La Mayiza - fell out in September 2024.
body.zh: 墨西哥网红 César Gastélum 在 TikTok 直播时被枪杀。 周二晚上，加斯特鲁姆正在北部城市库利亚坎特雷斯里奥斯的一家快餐店外与两名朋友一起拍摄，两名骑摩托车的男子向他驶来，其中一人近距离向他开枪。 他在 TikTok 上拥有超过 50 万粉丝，主要上传喜剧视频。 这并不是墨西哥第一次有社交媒体影响者被杀。去年，23 岁的瓦莱里娅·马尔克斯 (Valeria Márquez) 在 TikTok 上直播时在一家美容院被枪杀。 在直播中，加斯特鲁姆和他的朋友们穿着送货司机通常使用的亮橙色外套和袋子。 当地媒体报道称，警方最初认为他们的服装是一名送货司机，但后来官员们才得知他的身份。 警方和法医专家封锁了该地区，并正在检查弹壳和闭路电视录像以寻找任何线索。 目前尚未逮捕任何人，摩托车上的两人逃离了现场。 他经常在他的 Instagram 账户上分享旅行和夜晚外出的照片，或者在豪华车前摆姿势的照片。 在他的一篇帖子中，可以看到他在被称为“El Gordo Peruci”的影响者 Leobardo Aispuro 的坟墓前。 艾斯普罗于 2024 年 12 月被枪杀，警方称这起杀戮可能与锡那罗亚贩毒集团两个交战派系之间的竞争有关。 自洛斯查皮托斯 (Los Chapitos) 和拉马伊萨 (La Mayiza) 两派于 2024 年 9 月发生争执以来，库利亚坎为锡那罗亚州首府的暴力事件不断升级。

title.en: The Australians spending their European summer waiting for a 15-minute warning
title.zh: 澳大利亚人在欧洲度过夏天等待 15 分钟警告

summary.en: More Australian aerial firefighting pilots are spending the European summers helping local authorities battle wildfires.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
While most Australians in Europe are at the beach, NSW aerial firefighting pilot Alex Pay spends his long summer days at a Greek airbase, waiting for a call to action.

"When you get a fire call, you're gonna be airborne in 15 minutes," he told SBS News.

Once in the air, Pay can spend up to 10 hours supporting local authorities in Greece's fight against wildfires, which over the past week saw two pilots killed and hundreds of thousands forced to evacuate.

Pay, 31, works for a small but growing number of Australian private aerial firefighting companies based in Western Europe during this year's fire season, which is shaping up to be the continent's worst in record.

It also comes as Australia's own looming El Niño threatens to turn up the heat on our own summer bushfire risk .

Pay is a third-generation pilot with Pay's Air Service, which is based in the NSW Hunter Region.

"I remember as a kid flying with my dad to visit my grandparents," he told SBS News.

He pilots one of 14 aircraft his company has based throughout Greece for the summer. It’s his second season in the country, and the fifth overall for his company.

They fly a variant of the Air Tractor AT-802, nicknamed the "Fire Boss" — an amphibious aircraft that scoops water into a tank, or "hopper", controlled by a computerised fire gate that can be adjusted to match exact conditions.

In Australia, there were around 130 certified firefighting aeroplane operators or individual pilots, with a further 186 helicopter operators in 2021, according to Australia's Civil Aviation Authority.

Andrew Mackay is from Ballarat-based Field Air Group, which also has planes stationed in Greece this summer supporting Pay's.

"We like to say in our industry that it's not the aircraft that put out the fires, it's the ground crew — we're merely a tool to assist them," he told SBS News.

He said pilots will often work on either side of the fire to create a "triangle or an arrowhead, so the fire comes to a point where the ground crew can then extinguish that".

Sometimes they will drop water or retardant directly onto a house under threat from a blaze.

"We spent a lot of time training and preparing scenarios that give us a good education on what we might see on the fire ground," Pay said.

On Sunday, a Greek and a Danish national were killed after two helicopters collided while fighting a fire west of Athens.

The helicopters were leased from Australian company McDermott Aviation, which said in a statement it was "deeply saddened" by the tragedy.

title.en: As allies desert FIFA boss Gianni Infantino, is there anyone ready to replace him?
title.zh: 随着盟友抛弃国际足联主席詹尼·因凡蒂诺，谁能取代他？

summary.en: FIFA President Gianni Infantino is facing significant controversy, leading to a loss of support from allies and questions about his future leadership.
summary.zh: 国际足联主席詹尼·因凡蒂诺正面临重大争议，导致盟友失去支持，并引发对其未来领导的质疑。

body.en:
Pressure on FIFA president Gianni Infantino has intensified, with opposition emerging both within world football's governing body and from external critics over his since-abandoned proposal to open the World Cup to private investment.

Former Arsenal manager Arsene Wenger, appointed in 2019 by Infantino as FIFA's chief of global football development, said in a statement on Tuesday that "the decision to withdraw the project was absolutely necessary and beyond question".

His remarks followed hot on the heels of an extraordinary internal email to FIFA staff, seen by the Agence France-Presse (AFP) news agency, in which secretary-general Mattias Grafstrom appeared to distance himself from Infantino on the issue.

Previously seen as close to Infantino, Grafstrom describes the fiasco surrounding the plan as "a sad and reproachable series of events".

FIFA floated the plan last Tuesday, saying it could raise up to US$4.2 billion ($5.95 billion) of private investment based on a valuation of US$20 billion ($28 billion) for a new commercial subsidiary, called the FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE), which it proposed would handle commercial rights for events such as the World Cup and Club World Cup.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

By Saturday, it was dead in the water, as Infantino announced he was abandoning the plan after widespread condemnation, with European governing body UEFA having threatened to boycott all FIFA competitions, including the World Cup.

Far from calming the waters or shoring up his presidency, Infantino has been swamped with criticism of his leadership style; the previously smooth path to being re-elected unopposed for a fourth and final term next March now looks rocky.

However, re-election is a problem down the road. For now, Infantion has others to confront.

Even though he had withdrawn the scheme, UEFA issued a letter through their lawyers in the US threatening legal action over what they had scathingly described as a "shabby, backroom, opaque deal".

"You and FIFA are required to take immediate steps to identify, locate, and preserve all documents and electronically stored information described in this Notice that are in your or FIFA's possession, custody, or control," its lawyer Andrew Levander said in the letter sent last Friday and seen by AFP.

Several of UEFA's member associations — Wales, Finland, Sweden and Serbia — have withdrawn their letters of support for Infantino and the English FA is strongly rumoured to be on the verge of joining them.

body.en:
Reports suggest US President Donald Trump would be "very disappointed" if Israel doesn't agree to a new peace plan for Gaza, announced last week. But how far would the US go to make that happen?

But so far the new Gaza peace deal , announced last week and meant to help end the fighting and ease the ongoing humanitarian crisis in the coastal enclave, only seems to have resulted in another standoff between the key belligerents.

However, experts point out, there are some differences between this new peace deal and previous arrangements that could be positive.

For one thing, it is much more detailed and substantive. For another, statements by Trump indicate he might be more willing to push Israel towards accepting the deal. And finally, after resisting the idea for years, this month the Gaza-based group Hamas has agreed to disarm.

It was Hamas that sent fighters into Israel on October 7, 2023, an attack that resulted in over 1,000 deaths and sparked nearly three years of an ongoing Israeli military campaign in Gaza. The Israeli military has since killed over 73,000 people there , causing a UN independent commission of inquiry to classify its behavior as a genocide.

One of the main sticking points of any peace plan for Gaza has been the sequencing of events. Israel has demanded that Hamas disarm before it withdraws its troops from Gaza. But up until last month, Hamas had refused to disarm until Israel withdrew its troops. This led to an ongoing stalemate.

Early in July, Hamas agreed to hand over power to the National Committee for the Administration of Gaza , or NCAG, a group of independent technocrats set up to govern Gaza. Later in July, the group also agreed to hand over their weapons to the NCAG.

Hamas agreeing to disarm after years of promoting armed resistance against Israel should be taken seriously, says Muhammad Shehada, a visiting fellow with the Middle East and North Africa program at the European Council of Foreign Affairs, who is originally from Gaza .

Hamas has been under pressure from negotiators from other countries like Egypt and Qatar and this could also be something of a political tactic "to expose that Israel is the party that is obstructing any progress in Gaza under [Prime Minister Benjamin] Netanyahu's government," Shehada concedes.

But, he added, "they would not have made such a major, historic concession unless their backs were totally against the wall and they fully understood that this is the only way forward."

Should Israel agree to the new peace plan, there would also be no way Hamas could renege.

title.en: South Sudan: How climate change can result in toxic water
title.zh: 南苏丹：气候变化如何导致有毒水

summary.en: Years of persistent flooding have led to severe water pollution in South Sudan's primary oil-producing region. Local communities, scientists, and health workers are urgently seeking solutions, while the full extent of the crisis's long-term effects remains unknown.
summary.zh: 持续多年的洪灾已导致南苏丹主要产油区的水源受到严重污染。当地社区、科学家和卫生工作者正紧急寻求解决方案，而这场危机的长期影响尚不明朗。

body.en:
Years of flooding have resulted in disastrous water pollution in South Sudan's main oil region. As communities, scientists and health workers scramble for solutions, the long-term impacts of the crisis is yet to emerge.

The village of Bentiu has seen it all: Located in the north of South Sudan near the border with Sudan , the capital of Unity State used to have a population of merely several thousand people.

But war, violence and other crisis have resulted in an additional 140,000 displaced persons seeking shelter there since 2013, resulting in the establishment of a massive camp for internally displaced persons (IDPs).

Several UN bodies including the International Organization for Migration (IOM), the  UN Refugee Agency (UNHCR ) and the United Nations Children's Fund (UNICEF) are active on the ground, running what is known as the Protection of Civilians (POC) camp, which by now feels more like a permanent structure.

At a makeshift pier, children are seen playing, countless canoes bring in fish to feed scores of people at the camp, where food insecurity remains a chief concern.

Immediately, each day's yield is separated into two categories: One stock with fresh, healthy fish, and another for those believed to be contaminated. 

Simon Gatkuoth, a camp resident in his early forties, lifts a fish from a wheelbarrow, explaining that fish that are caught near the oil fields are contaminated: "When we cook them, the soup sometimes smells like penicillin," he says.

"But there is no option. We have to eat. We cannot stop eating because there is no alternative."

Viewed from the sky, the POC Camp resembles an artificial island in the midst of a region that has been transformed into what appears to be a gigantic lake. 

Here, the largely nomadic communities of South Sudan's Unity State have long adapted their lives to the seasonal floods that shape life in what is one of the world's largest wetlands known as the Sudd.

But in 2021, and unprecedented deluge of floods linked to climate change submerged farmland across the region, destroying livelihoods and killing thousands of cattle.

Just one year earlier, authorities in neighboring Uganda had issued a warning that rising levels in Lake Victoria, situated roughly 1,000 kilometers (650 miles) to the south, would require the release of large volumes of water into the White Nile river, which flows past Bentiu.

But South Sudan, one of the poorest countries, lacked the dams, flood-control systems and water-management infrastructure needed to cope with the flooding, leaving many communities highly vulnerable to flooding.

Maintained by the IOM, a simple levee is all that separates the POC Camp from the flooded plain; without constant maintenance, it would give way to the water.

title.zh: 赞比亚反对派在埃德加·伦古去世后将何去何从？

summary.en: The passing of former President Edgar Lungu has reshaped Zambia's opposition politics ahead of the August 13 general election. Analysts are observing whether his legacy will be sufficient to maintain unity among opposition supporters.
summary.zh: 前总统埃德加·伦古的去世重塑了赞比亚反对派的政治格局，而8月13日的大选即将到来。分析人士正在观察他的政治遗产能否继续维系反对派支持者的团结。

body.en:
The death of former President Edgar Lungu reshaped opposition politics in Zambia ahead of the August 13 general election. Analysts say the vote will test whether his legacy can keep opposition supporters united.

Zambia 's opposition is entering the 2026 general election without Edgar Lungu, the politician who for years united its biggest parties and inspired much of its support. Lungu, the country's former president, died in South Africa on June 5, 2025 .

Opposition parties have since been competing to inherit his political legacy while trying to convince voters they remain a credible alternative to incumbent Hakainde Hichilema's ruling United Party for National Development (UPND).

Lungu had led the now dismantled Patriotic Front (PF) party, a faction of which became part of Zambia's overall opposition Tonse Alliance in 2024. The former president had also intitially been fronted as the coalition's 2026 presidential candidate.

Political analyst Neo Simutanyi says Lungu's absence exposes an unresolved leadership question within the opposition coalition.

"He had a Plan B. He intended to back someone who would carry forward his political project, but he never had the opportunity to announce that person before he died," Simutanyi told DW.

Competing claims emerged over who should lead the Tonse Alliance emerged after Lungu's death. The coalition, now rebranded as the Tonse Pamodzi Alliance, has endorsed Brian Mundubile as its 2026 presidential candidate. He and Lungu were PF allies, while his running mate, Makebi Zulu, was Lungu's lawyer. Mundubile is widely seen as Hichilema's top challenger.

Simutanyi believes Lungu's influence nevertheless remains significant. "It is effectively a PF campaign without the PF label," he said, adding that several candidates are appealing to the same support base by presenting themselves as heirs to Lungu's legacy.

"The Edgar Lungu factor is still at play because candidates are campaigning on his legacy and many of the areas where he enjoyed strong support remain politically competitive."

Lungu's influence remains particularly visible on the Copperbelt, Zambia's mining heartland  and one of the country's most competitive electoral battlegrounds.

"Edgar Lungu's absence has left a big vacuum in the opposition, especially in the Patriotic Front. He was the one holding the party together," said Agness Tembo, a young leader from the Copperbelt.

She warned that a fragmented opposition could weaken Zambia's competitive multiparty democracy. But not all voters believe personalities will decide the election.

body.zh: 在 8 月 13 日大选之前，前总统埃德加·伦古 (Edgar Lungu) 的去世重塑了赞比亚的反对派政治。分析人士表示，这次投票将考验他的遗产能否让反对派支持者团结起来。 赞比亚反对派将在没有埃德加·伦古 (Edgar Lungu) 的情况下参加 2026 年大选，这位政治家多年来团结了赞比亚最大的政党并赢得了很多支持。该国前总统伦古于 2025 年 6 月 5 日在南非去世。 此后，反对党一直在竞相继承他的政治遗产，同时试图说服选民，他们仍然是现任哈凯恩德·希奇勒马领导的执政国家发展联合党（UPND）的可靠替代方案。 伦古曾领导现已解散的爱国阵线 (PF) 党，该党的一个派系于 2024 年成为赞比亚总体反对党通斯联盟 (Tonse Alliance) 的一部分。这位前总统最初也被视为该联盟 2026 年总统候选人。 政治分析家尼奥·西穆塔尼 (Neo Simutanyi) 表示，伦古的缺席暴露了反对派联盟内部尚未解决的领导问题。 “他有一个B计划。他打算支持一个能够推进他的政治计划的人，但他在去世前从未有机会宣布这个人，”西穆塔尼告诉德国之声。 伦古死后，关于谁应该领导通斯联盟的争论出现了。该联盟现已更名为 Tonse Pamodzi Alliance，已认可布莱恩·蒙杜比莱 (Brian Mundubile) 为其 2026 年总统候选人。他和伦古是爱国阵线的盟友，而他的竞选搭档马克比祖鲁是伦古的律师。蒙杜比莱被广泛视为希奇莱马的最大挑战者。 斯穆塔尼相信伦古的影响力仍然很大。他说：“这实际上是一场没有爱国阵线标签的爱国阵线竞选活动。”他补充说，几位候选人通过将自己描绘成伦古遗产的继承人来吸引同样的支持基础。 “埃德加·伦古因素仍在发挥作用，因为候选人正在利用他的遗产进行竞选，而他享有大力支持的许多领域仍然具有政治竞争力。” 伦古的影响力在赞比亚的采矿中心地带铜带省和该国最具竞争力的选举战场之一仍然尤为明显。 “埃德加·伦古的缺席给反对派留下了巨大的真空，特别是在爱国阵线。他是让该党团结在一起的人，”来自铜带省的年轻领导人阿格尼丝·滕博说。 她警告说，四分五裂的反对派可能会削弱赞比亚竞争性的多党民主。但并非所有选民都相信个性将决定选举。 另一位铜带省居民理查德·姆万巴 (Richard Mwamba) 表示，许多人更关心自己的日常生活，而不是政治继承。 “这次选举将不再是关于......

title.en: Spain clashes with EU countries in heated talks over migration fallout
title.zh: 西班牙与欧盟国家在移民问题上发生激烈冲突

summary.en: An estimated 60,000 people rushed into Spain's North African territory, causing major concerns throughout the European Union.
summary.zh: 估计有六万人涌入西班牙的北非领土，引发了整个欧盟的重大关切。

body.en:
Spain's interior minister headed into a tense face-off with EU counterparts on Tuesday, as the bloc sought to draw lessons from an influx of migrants into Spain's North African enclave of Ceuta in hastily arranged video talks.

The unprecedented sight of an estimated 60,000 people streaming into Ceuta from Morocco — dozens died in the attempt and almost all have since left — exposed the fault lines on migration among EU nations.

Since images first emerged of the mass arrivals, most of whom swam around a barrier separating the enclave from Morocco, the Spanish government has found itself pitted against many of its EU partners.

The bloc's interior ministers dialled in for a videoconference that could provide a chance to look for common ground — but looked equally likely to set the stage for a showdown.

While Spain moved swiftly to send migrants back from Ceuta — where it said an estimated 2,500 remained as of Monday — the government of Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez backs a more open approach to migration than most of its EU counterparts.

Countries pushing a harder line are led most vocally by Italy — whose Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has attacked Madrid's stance, and specifically a recent push to grant legal status to undocumented migrants already in the country.

Both Italy and Denmark last week advocated suspending Spain from the Schengen free-travel area over the Ceuta crisis — a notion firmly rejected by Madrid, and which in any case is legally impossible under EU rules.

In a letter to the heads of the EU's institutions Saturday, Sanchez accused fellow EU countries of having "selfish" attitudes and called for emergency talks to work on a "common response" to such incidents.

Within hours, 22 countries led by Italy, Denmark, Germany and Hungary sent a counter-letter also demanding urgent talks, but with a different goal: to continue pressing their tough stance on immigration.

In a taste of what to expect, preparatory talks among the bloc's EU ambassadors on Monday saw Spain's envoy voice "frustration" with a perceived lack of support from fellow capitals, one EU diplomat told the Agence-France Presse (AFP) news agency.

Conversely — while all assured Madrid of their "solidarity" — some member states "are asking themselves if recent policies adopted by Spain have not sent the signal that the doors are open", added the diplomat.

The EU has significantly tightened its migration rules in recent months, including by allowing member states to send failed asylum seekers to so-called "return hubs" located outside the bloc's borders.

title.en: 'Urgent' call for military build-up in Australia's backyard amid Chinese, Russian threats
title.zh: 澳大利亚后院因中俄威胁而“紧急”呼吁军事集结

summary.en: Tensions are escalating in the Pacific region, prompting one nation to significantly increase its military capabilities due to growing distrust among key international actors.
summary.zh: 太平洋地区紧张局势加剧，主要国际参与者之间的不信任感导致一个国家大幅推动重新武装。

body.en:
Japan needs to boost its military with a "sense of urgency and crisis", its defence minister said on Tuesday, as a new government assessment reiterated growing risks posed by China, North Korea, and Russia.

Japan is already beefing up military spending and security cooperation in Asia, deploying missile launchers to outer islands, moving to acquire "counter-strike" capabilities, and easing rules on weapons exports.

But Shinjiro Koizumi said in a preface to the annual defence white paper that it was "imperative that Japan further reinforce and transform its defence capabilities with a stronger sense of urgency and crisis than ever before".

In the Asia-Pacific, "not only are China and North Korea further strengthening their military capabilities, China-Russia and Russia-North Korea are also reinforcing their cooperation", he added.

The new white paper said China was "intensifying its activities" in the region around Japan, "extending beyond the so-called first island chain to the second island chain".

It listed a series of incidents in 2025, including activities by Chinese aircraft carriers and the "unusual close approach" by Chinese aircraft to Japanese planes in two incidents in June and July.

Japanese jets scrambled 595 times in the year to 31 March 2026, including 366 sorties against Chinese aircraft and 214 for Russian planes.

Japan decided in April to lift its self-imposed ban on weapons exports, but the white paper highlighted problems in the country's production base that could jeopardise procurement and innovation.

Koizumi also said that he and US counterpart Pete Hegseth had "exchanged candid views" on the "unwavering" US-Japan alliance, while also increasing security cooperation with the Philippines, Australia, and South Korea to realise a "a free and open Indo-Pacific".

"As the security environment becomes increasingly and rapidly severe, what is required now is to strengthen resilience against crises all across the entire Indo-Pacific region," Koizumi said.

"In order to do so Japan will build and expand multilayered networks among allies and like-minded countries, and enhance interconnectivity with like-minded countries and others in every area."

The link between defence and future prosperity comes as Takaichi's administration prepares a new national security strategy.

Military experts expect it to call for further spending increases aimed primarily at deterring China from starting a conflict with Taiwan that could also draw Japan into a prolonged war.

title.zh: 改变我的时刻：我发现了一本禁忌小说——它导致了一段危险而持久的爱情

summary.en: Growing up in the Chinese region of Xinjiang, romance was frowned upon – as was much of my Uyghur culture. But one day, exploring a strange house, I found a gateway to both worlds Many people have a book that changes their life. For me and my wife, one book in particular changed...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Growing up in the Chinese region of Xinjiang, romance was frowned upon – as was much of my Uyghur culture. But one day, exploring a strange house, I found a gateway to both worlds Many people have a book that changes their life. For me and my wife, one book in particular changed our destinies for ever. We have been in love since we were teenagers, and today we are happily married – all because I accidentally discovered a forbidden novel in someone else’s house. It was a hot summer’s evening in 2009, in Kumul, Xinjiang. I was 16 and my father insisted I accompany him to visit a distant relative, where they would spend hours chatting about the old days and feasting as if they hadn’t eaten in years. As the well-behaved teenager I tried to be, I sat politely, nodding at their stories and pretending to absorb their “life lessons”, attempting to hide my boredom. The living room, with its small windows and bright lighting, was unbearable. Continue reading...
body.zh: 我在中国新疆地区长大，浪漫是不受欢迎的——就像我的维吾尔文化一样。但有一天，在探索一栋陌生的房子时，我发现了通往两个世界的大门许多人都有一本改变他们生活的书。对于我和我的妻子来说，有一本书永远改变了我们的命运。我们从少年时就相爱，到今天幸福地结婚了——这一切都是因为我无意中在别人家里发现了一本禁书。 2009年，新疆哈密尔一个炎热的夏夜。我当时 16 岁，父亲坚持让我陪他去拜访一位远房亲戚，他们会花上几个小时谈论过去的时光，然后大吃大喝，就好像他们已经很多年没有吃饭一样了。作为一个我努力成为的乖孩子，我礼貌地坐着，对他们的故事点头，假装吸收他们的“人生教训”，试图隐藏我的无聊。客厅的窗户很小，灯光明亮，令人难以忍受。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到和平与克制。Matthew 5:9提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以怜悯、真实与节制来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Trump administration reportedly drafting ban on Chinese datacenter components
title.zh: 据报道，特朗普政府正起草一项针对中国数据中心组件的禁令

summary.en: The Trump administration is reportedly preparing a ban on US imports of new Chinese datacenter components. This measure, being developed by the FCC, signals an effort by US authorities to address concerns related to technology and trade.
summary.zh: 据报道，特朗普政府正在起草一项禁止美国进口新型中国数据中心组件的禁令。这项由联邦通信委员会（FCC）制定的措施，表明美国当局正努力应对与技术和贸易相关的担忧。

body.en: Trump’s FCC is developing a measure to bar US imports of new models of Chinese datacenter devices, sources say The Trump administration is reportedly drafting a ban on US imports of new models of Chinese datacenter components, in the latest sign US authorities are scrambling to respond to the rapid development of AI technology in China . Four people familiar with the matter told Reuters that the Federal Communications Commission (FCC), which oversees the US ⁠telecommunications industry, is developing a measure to bar imports of new ​Chinese optical transceivers, which allow data to travel over fiber-optic cables at the speed of light within datacenters. Officials hope to publish the measure this year, according to Reuters. Continue reading...
body.zh: 消息人士称，特朗普政府的联邦通信委员会正在制定一项措施，禁止美国进口新型中国数据中心设备。 据报道，特朗普政府正在起草一项禁止美国进口新型中国数据中心组件的禁令，这是美国当局正忙于应对中国人工智能技术快速发展的最新迹象。四名知情人士告诉路透社，负责监管美国电信行业的联邦通信委员会（FCC）正在制定一项措施，禁止进口新型中国光收发器，这些光收发器允许数据在数据中心内通过光纤电缆以光速传输。据路透社报道，官员们希望今年公布这项措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In a world of complex technological dependencies and geopolitical tensions, nations often seek to anticipate and mitigate potential risks. Proverbs 27:12 reminds us of the wisdom in foreseeing danger and taking prudent steps to protect what is valuable. Such foresight, applied with integrity, can guide leaders in navigating intricate global challenges.
reflection.zh: 在一个技术相互依赖和地缘政治紧张复杂的世界中，各国常常寻求预见并减轻潜在风险。箴言27:12提醒我们，预见危险并采取审慎措施保护宝贵之物是智慧之举。这种以正直为基础的远见，能够指引领导者应对错综复杂的全球挑战。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: Stock market turmoil sheds stark light on the opaque AI economy
title.zh: 股市动荡揭示不透明的人工智能经济

summary.en: Investors scramble to make sense of a shock Chinese challenge to the dominance of western chipmakers, leading to a particularly volatile week in the AI economy.
summary.zh: 投资者急于理解中国对西方芯片制造商主导地位的冲击，这导致人工智能经济在上周经历了特别剧烈的波动。

body.en: Investors scramble to make sense of a shock Chinese challenge to the dominance of western chipmakers Even for the rollercoaster world of AI, last week was particularly volatile as investors scrambled to keep up with developments that threatened the dominance of the largest western chipmakers. It began with a double whammy. On Monday, the Chinese memory chipmaker CXMT floated on the Shanghai stock market, soaring by 466% in value to 3.3tn yuan (£365bn). Continue reading...
body.zh: 投资者争先恐后地理解中国对西方芯片制造商主导地位的令人震惊的挑战即使对于像过山车一样的人工智能世界来说，上周也特别动荡，因为投资者争先恐后地跟上威胁西方最大芯片制造商主导地位的发展。它开始于双重打击。周一，中国存储芯片制造商长鑫存储在上海股市上市，市值飙升 466% 至 3.3 亿元人民币（3,650 亿英镑）。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid shifts and opaque nature of the AI economy, as seen in recent market turmoil, highlight how quickly human understanding can be overwhelmed by complex systems. In moments when investors scramble to make sense of unpredictable developments, Proverbs 3:5 reminds us to lean not on our own understanding, but to trust in Yahweh with all our heart. This...
reflection.zh: 人工智能经济的快速变化和不透明性，正如近期市场动荡所显示，突显了人类理解力在复杂系统面前的局限。当投资者努力理解不可预测的发展时，箴言3:5提醒我们不要依靠自己的聪明，而要全心信赖雅伟。这鼓励我们在自身洞察力有限时，保持谦卑并依靠神的智慧。

verse.textEn: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.
verse.textZh: 你要专心仰赖雅伟，不可倚靠自己的聪明。

title.en: China has banned hidden retractable car door handles. How are they dangerous – and what will Australia do?
title.zh: 中国已禁止隐藏式可伸缩汽车门把手。它们为何危险？澳大利亚会效仿吗？

summary.en: China has banned hidden retractable car door handles, citing their failure to operate during accidents and trapping passengers in burning vehicles. These handles were popularized by Tesla electric vehicles, and the move raises questions about whether other countries like Australia will follow suit.
summary.zh: 中国已禁止使用隐藏式可伸缩汽车门把手，理由是它们在事故中可能失灵，导致乘客被困在燃烧的车辆中。特斯拉电动汽车普及了这种门把手，此举引发了其他国家（如澳大利亚）是否会效仿的疑问。

body.en: The handles, which were popularised by Elon Musk’s Tesla EVs, have a record of failing and trapping passengers inside burning vehicles during deadly accidents Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast They used to be a novelty in Australia: the futuristic, flush-mounted car door handles favoured by Elon Musk’s Tesla. However while the design – popularised with the Tesla Model S in 2012 and since adopted by other manufacturers – might look sleek, it may not be great in an emergency. Continue reading...
body.zh: 这些把手因埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的特斯拉电动汽车而广受欢迎，但在致命事故中曾发生过故障，并将乘客困在燃烧的车辆内。 关注我们的澳大利亚新闻直播博客，了解最新动态 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 它们曾经是澳大利亚的新奇事物：埃隆·马斯克 (Telsas) 青睐的未来派嵌入式汽车门把手。然而，虽然这种设计在 2012 年随特斯拉 Model S 流行起来，后来被其他制造商采用，但虽然看起来很时尚，但在紧急情况下可能不太好。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The ban on retractable car door handles highlights the importance of foresight in design and technology. A prudent person foresees danger and takes precautions, reminding us that innovation must always be balanced with safety and the well-being of others. This decision underscores the responsibility to protect lives by addressing foreseeable risks, even in...
reflection.zh: 对可伸缩汽车门把手的禁令突显了设计和技术中预见危险的重要性。通达人预见祸患就藏躲，提醒我们创新必须始终与安全和他人福祉相平衡。这一决定强调了通过解决可预见的风险来保护生命的责任，即使是在看似微小的设计选择中。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: China’s tech advances are causing chaos from Silicon Valley to the White House
title.zh: 中国的科技进步正在从硅谷到白宫引发混乱

summary.en: Recent advancements in China's artificial intelligence, chip manufacturing, and robotics technologies have caused significant disruption in global financial markets and the US tech industry.
summary.zh: 中国在人工智能、芯片制造和机器人技术方面取得的最新进展，已在全球金融市场和美国科技行业引发了显著的震荡。

body.en: New AI models, advanced robots and specialty computer chips are unsettling markets and the US tech industry Over the past month, a series of advancements in China’s artificial intelligence, chip manufacturing and robotics technologies have rattled financial markets, caused divisions among US tech moguls and left the Trump administration scrambling to respond. Silicon Valley has long pointed to China’s tech industry as a competitive threat and used its growth as rationale for why US firms should not face regulatory oversight that could slow them down. In recent weeks, however, China’s progress has pushed US tech CEOs past vague warnings and into open disagreement over how to address Chinese-made products upending their industry. Continue reading...
body.zh: 新的人工智能模型、先进机器人和专用计算机芯片令市场和美国科技行业感到不安。过去一个月，中国人工智能、芯片制造和机器人技术的一系列进步震惊了金融市场，引发了美国科技大亨之间的分歧，并让特朗普政府仓促应对。硅谷长期以来一直将中国科技行业视为竞争威胁，并以中国科技行业的增长作为美国企业不应面临可能放慢发展速度的监管监督的理由。然而，最近几周，中国的进步让美国科技公司的首席执行官不再发出含糊的警告，而是在如何解决颠覆其行业的中国制造产品问题上产生了公开分歧。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid pace of technological innovation, particularly in AI and robotics, reflects a time when knowledge is indeed increasing at an unprecedented rate. This acceleration can bring both wonder and apprehension as societies grapple with its profound implications. In such moments, we are reminded to seek wisdom beyond mere information, trusting Yahweh to...
reflection.zh: 人工智能和机器人技术等领域的快速创新步伐，正反映出知识以前所未有的速度增长的时代。这种加速既带来惊奇，也引发担忧，因为社会正在努力应对其深远影响。在这样的时刻，我们被提醒要寻求超越单纯信息的智慧，信靠雅伟引导我们穿越新的领域。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: World-renowned climber Nirmal Purja among 11 struck by avalanche on Pakistan mountain
title.zh: 世界著名登山家尼尔马尔·普尔贾等11人在巴基斯坦山脉遭遇雪崩

summary.en: World-renowned climber Nirmal Purja was among 11 mountaineers caught in a deadly avalanche on Broad Peak in Pakistan. Rescuers have found four bodies as the search continues for the team.
summary.zh: 世界著名登山家尼尔马尔·普尔贾是11名在巴基斯坦布洛阿特峰遭遇致命雪崩的登山者之一。救援人员已找到四具遗体，搜寻工作仍在进行中。

body.en: Rescuers say four bodies found in search for team caught in Broad Peak avalanche, after trackers showed rapid descent The world-renowned Nepali mountaineer Nirmal Purja – a former British special forces member – is among 11 climbers caught in a deadly avalanche on Pakistan’s Broad Peak. The Alpine Club of Pakistan said “seven climbers have been spotted via aerial drone footage” adding that “their identities and condition cannot yet be verified”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 救援人员称，在追踪器显示快速下降后，在寻找布洛阿特峰雪崩中陷入雪崩的登山队时，发现了四具尸体。世界著名的尼泊尔登山家尼尔马尔·普贾（Nirmal Purja）是一名前英国特种部队成员，他是巴基斯坦布洛阿特峰遭遇雪崩的 11 名登山者之一。巴基斯坦高山俱乐部表示，“通过无人机航拍发现了七名登山者”，并补充说“他们的身份和状况尚未得到证实”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The tragic news of climbers caught in an avalanche reminds us of life's fragility and the suddenness of loss. In moments of profound grief and pain, we hold onto the promise that one day Yahweh will wipe away every tear. This hope assures us that suffering, mourning, and death will ultimately pass away.
reflection.zh: 登山者遭遇雪崩的悲剧性新闻提醒我们生命的脆弱和失去的突然。在极度悲伤和痛苦的时刻，我们紧紧抓住雅伟有一天将擦去我们所有眼泪的应许。这个盼望向我们保证，苦难、哀伤和死亡终将过去。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: From petitions to memes: How students made dissent visible
title.zh: 从请愿到网络迷因：学生如何让异议显现

summary.en: Student movements throughout history, from imperial China to modern India, have consistently found new ways to express dissent and challenge established authority, adapting their methods to contemporary tools and symbols.
summary.zh: 从中国古代到当今印度，学生运动不断调整其工具和象征，以挑战权威，使异议得以显现。

body.en:
From imperial China to present-day India, student movements have repeatedly adapted the tools and symbols of their age to challenge authority.

On July 22, 2026, in rainy Mumbai, India , a casually dressed young woman stepped in front of a slow-moving police van carrying detained students. She placed her palm on the hood, forcing the vehicle to stop.

Mobile phones captured the moment from every angle. She too, raised her own phone and recorded the encounter. Within hours, the clip spread across India and beyond.

It became one of the defining visuals of the Cockroach Janta Party protests, a movement in which students demanded transparency and accountability, following leaks in India's medical entrance exams.

But the power of the moment lay not only in what she did, but in how quickly it was seen. A single gesture, a young woman confronting authority , became a symbol shared across millions of screens.

While the clip belongs to a generation raised on social media, the impulse behind it is much older.

From court petitions and revolutionary posters to photographs, umbrellas and memes, student movements have repeatedly adapted the tools and symbols available to them, turning them into vehicles for dissent.

Long before television or social media carried dissent across borders, students still found ways to make their grievances heard.

In Eastern Han China, for instance, scholars at the Imperial Academy (Taixue) aligned with reform-minded officials in opposing powerful eunuchs at court, whom many viewed as corrupt and politically overbearing.

They voiced their objections through public criticism, political networks and petitions.

In an era when political communication moved through official channels, petitions were among the established ways of bringing grievances before the throne. Written in formal language and delivered through the bureaucracy, they carried student concerns directly into the state's communication system.

In Paris in 1968, students challenged university authorities and a conservative postwar social order. As demonstrations spread across the French capital and drew in workers, one of the movement's most enduring contributions emerged from a basement workshop at the Ecole des Beaux-Arts.

The Atelier Populaire ("People's Workshop") printed thousands of posters during the protests, many of them overnight. Their bold graphics, silhouettes and slogans became the visual language of the movement. Produced collectively, many carried no individual author's name, helping transform protest into a shared public voice.

The posters and their messages could appear in dozens of places overnight, giving the protest a wide local visual presence.

Protests also became more impactful when images could be transmitted across borders.

body.zh: 从中华帝国到当今的印度，学生运动不断地采用他们那个时代的工具和符号来挑战权威。 2026 年 7 月 22 日，在多雨的印度孟买，一名穿着休闲的年轻女子走到一辆载着被拘留学生的缓慢行驶的警车前。她将手掌放在引擎盖上，迫使车辆停了下来。 手机从各个角度捕捉了这一时刻。她也举起了自己的手机，记录了这次遭遇。几个小时内，这段视频就传遍了印度及其他地区。 它成为蟑螂简塔党抗议活动的标志性视觉效果之一，在印度医学入学考试泄密后，学生们在这场运动中要求透明度和问责制。 但这一刻的​​力量不仅在于她所做的事情，还在于她的所作所为很快被人们看到。一个年轻女子对抗权威的一个动作，成为了数百万屏幕上共享的符号。 虽然这段视频属于在社交媒体上长大的一代人，但其背后的冲动却要古老得多。 从法庭请愿书和革命海报到照片、雨伞和模因，学生运动不断地调整他们可用的工具和符号，将它们变成异议的工具。 早在电视或社交媒体跨境传播异议之前，学生们就已经找到了表达不满的方法。 例如，在中国东汉，太学的学者与具有改革思想的官员结盟，反对宫廷中有权有势的宦官，许多人认为宦官腐败且在政治上专横。 他们通过公开批评、政治网络和请愿来表达他们的反对意见。 在政治沟通通过官方渠道进行的时代，请愿是向王室表达不满的既定方式之一。它们以正式语言编写并通过官僚机构传达，将学生的担忧直接传达到国家的沟通系统中。 1968 年的巴黎，学生们挑战大学当局和保守的战后社会秩序。随着示威活动在法国首都蔓延并吸引了工人，该运动最持久的贡献之一来自巴黎美术学院的一个地下室工作室。 Atelier Populaire（“人民工作室”）在抗议期间印制了数千张海报，其中许多是在一夜之间印制的。他们大胆的图形、轮廓和口号成为了这场运动的视觉语言。许多作品都是集体制作的，没有作者的名字，这有助于将抗议转变为公众的共同声音。 这些海报及其信息可能会在一夜之间出现在数十个地方，使抗议活动在当地得到广泛的关注。 当图像可以跨境传输时，抗议的影响力也变得更大。 在...

reflection.en: Student movements, by making their dissent visible, often echo a deep human longing for fairness and moral order. Yahweh, through the prophet Amos, calls for justice to flow powerfully and consistently, reminding us that true righteousness should be an undeniable force in society. This pursuit of a more just world often requires courage to speak truth to...
reflection.zh: 学生运动通过使异议显现，常常回应着人类对公平和道德秩序的深切渴望。雅伟通过先知阿摩司呼吁，愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔，提醒我们真正的公义应成为社会中不可否认的力量。这种对更公正世界的追求，往往需要勇气向权力说出真相，即使这意味着挑战现状。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Chinese super-embassy in London to go ahead after high court challenge dismissed
title.zh: 中国驻伦敦超级大使馆在高院驳回挑战后将继续建设

summary.en: A high court in London has dismissed a challenge from local residents against the construction of a new Chinese embassy. The residents' association, which sought to stop planning permission, has announced its intention to appeal the ruling.
summary.zh: 伦敦高等法院驳回了当地居民对中国新大使馆建设的挑战。寻求阻止规划许可的居民协会表示将对该裁决提出上诉。

title.en: US-China AI rivalry heats up as Chinese models gain ground
title.zh: 中美人工智能竞争加剧，中国模型迎头赶上

summary.en: China's AI platforms are rapidly advancing, narrowing the gap with US technology. This progress has led to renewed threats from the Trump administration, alongside accusations of intellectual property theft, raising concerns about escalating tensions between the two nations.
summary.zh: 中国的人工智能平台正迅速缩小与美国同行的差距。这一进展引发了特朗普政府新的威胁，并伴随着知识产权盗窃的指控，令人担忧两国之间的紧张关系可能升级。

body.en:
China's AI platforms are rapidly closing the gap with their US counterparts, prompting fresh threats from the Trump administration. With accusations of intellectual property theft, could tensions boil over?

In what seems like the blink of an eye,  China has gone from being up to five years behind the United States in top-tier artificial intelligence (AI) to lagging by just a few months.

While US players, including Anthropic's Claude and OpenAI's ChatGPT , have spent hundreds of billions of dollars to push the frontier of AI, China has pursued a very different path .

Faced with US curbs on high-end chips that help AI to do its most advanced thinking, Chinese tech firms have prioritized dozens of open-source AI models built on "good enough"  technology .

These platforms, including DeepSeek, Alibaba's Qwen and Xiaomi's MiMo, are now widely deployed across Chinese businesses, government services and consumer devices.

In the latest sign of the gap closing, Chinese startup Moonshot AI last week unveiled Kimi K3, a model that rivals one of the most advanced AI models — Anthropic's Claude Fable 5 — on key benchmarks.

In some tests, Kimi K3 matches or even surpasses Claude with far less computing power and at a fraction of the cost. 

Global technology specialist Alvin W. Graylin thinks Kimi K3's arrival turns high-end AI from an expensive luxury into something practical and affordable.

"For 98% of customers, the 1 to 2% difference [in knowledge] isn't worth paying 10 to 20 times more."

China's latest advance has already drawn a strong reaction from Washington, with US President Donald Trump now threatening to block US access to Chinese AI models.

Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, meanwhile, warned earlier this week that the US could sanction Chinese models over alleged intellectual property (IP) theft.

Anthropic  and OpenAI have accused Chinese labs of using their models to train their own systems, a process known as distilling.

While distilling is a common practice by AI labs worldwide to a limited extent, the companies say their models have been bombarded with queries to harvest advanced reasoning. The White House warned in April that China was doing it on an "industrial scale."

Beijing has hit back, rejecting the accusations as baseless and calling US threats of sanctions and model bans "technological bullying" to contain China's rise.

Giulia Neaher, a research analyst at the Strategic Foresight Hub at the Washington-based Stimson Center think tank, downplayed the role of distilling in Kimi's progress.

body.zh: 中国的人工智能平台正在迅速缩小与美国同行的差距，引发了特朗普政府的新威胁。随着知识产权盗窃的指控，紧张局势会升级吗？ 似乎一眨眼的功夫，中国在顶级人工智能 (AI) 领域就从落后美国五年变为仅落后几个月。 尽管包括 Anthropic 的 Claude 和 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 在内的美国企业已经花费了数千亿美元来推动人工智能的前沿发展，但中国却走了一条截然不同的道路。 面对美国对帮助人工智能实现最先进思维的高端芯片的限制，中国科技公司优先考虑了数十种基于“足够好”技术的开源人工智能模型。 这些平台，包括 DeepSeek、阿里巴巴的 Qwen 和小米的 MiMo，现已广泛部署在中国企业、政府服务和消费设备中。 作为缩小差距的最新迹象，中国初创公司 Moonshot AI 上周推出了 Kimi K3，该模型在关键基准测试上可与最先进的人工智能模型之一——Anthropic 的 Claude Fable 5 相媲美。 在某些测试中，Kimi K3 可以与 Claude 相媲美甚至超过 Claude，但其计算能力却要低得多，而成本却只是 Claude 的一小部分。 全球技术专家 Alvin W. Graylin 认为 Kimi K3 的到来将高端人工智能从昂贵的奢侈品变成了实用且负担得起的东西。 “对于 98% 的客户来说，[知识] 1% 到 2% 的差异并不值得多付 10 到 20 倍的费用。” 中国的最新进展已经引起华盛顿的强烈反应，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普现在威胁要阻止美国使用中国的人工智能模型。 与此同时，财政部长斯科特·贝森特本周早些时候警告称，美国可能会因涉嫌盗窃知识产权而制裁中国模型。 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 指责中国实验室使用他们的模型来训练他们自己的系统，这一过程被称为蒸馏。 虽然提炼是全球人工智能实验室在一定程度上的常见做法，但这些公司表示，他们的模型已经受到查询的轰炸，以收获高级推理。白宫四月份警告说，中国正在以“工业规模”这样做。 北京方面予以反击，否认这些指控毫无根据，并称美国威胁实施制裁和示范禁令是“技术欺凌”，旨在遏制中国的崛起。 华盛顿智库史汀生中心战略远见中心的研究分析师朱莉娅·尼赫（Giulia Neaher）淡化了提炼在基米进步中的作用。 “[其成功]很大程度上归功于为建设这个项目而投入的人才、基础设施和资源......

A Sydney woman has been charged with 62 offences after allegedly sending threatening letters to organisations and individuals, including politicians, a place of worship and a media outlet.

This follows the investigation by a newly formed strike force established in response to “a large volume of letters” sent to several individuals and organisations.

Officers searched a home in Constitution Hill last month, seizing electronic devices before arresting the 36-year-old woman on Wednesday.

The charges include sending letters containing threats of death or grievous bodily harm, stalking and intimidation, and dishonestly obtaining financial advantage by deception.

summary.en: Experts note a global surge in camera and smart glasses, but warn that regulating and enforcing rules for this wearable technology presents significant complexities.

body.en:
Kmart recently launched a new accessory — dubbed Camera Glasses — which it said blends stylish eyewear with built-in camera technology.

At a glance, the black-framed spectacles from Kmart's in-house brand Anko look like any ordinary pair of glasses. But by Monday 3 August, there were reports the product was sold out online.

At $89, the glasses provide a low-cost alternative to the smart glasses designed by glasses company Ray-Ban and Facebook owners Meta, which start at $337. The latest generation of this technology costs more than $700.

A recent promotional video for Ray-Ban Meta AI glasses, featuring celebrity Kylie Jenner, showcased its features. Those include an ultra-HD camera, discreet open-ear Bluetooth speakers, and translation technology.

In July, Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg said people who don't wear smart glasses in the future will be at a "pretty significant cognitive disadvantage".

There are similar products available or in development by the companies Samsung, Rokid, Even Realities, Solos and XREAL.

Milica Stilinovic is a postdoctoral research associate for the Governing Immersive Tech Project at the University of Sydney. She told SBS News that "a lot of flak has been driven towards Meta currently because they are market leaders".

But she said: "If the price is cheaper ... if you're not paying at the bridge, you may pay at the toll.

"We still need to ask ourselves, this data that we're essentially generating for these companies; how is it being handled, by whom and at what cost?"

Stilinovic also said wearable technology, regardless of its price point, raises complex questions around privacy and security.

Depending on the product, they may have AI-enabled programs embedded, which analyse human behaviours including eye movements, head tracking and voice patterns.

"They are picking up data of where you're walking around, the space that you're in, what you're doing at particular times ... even to the extent of knowing the map out of your home," Stilinovic said.

Facial recognition technology is not active in most smart glasses on the market.

However, in 2024, students from Harvard University combined smart glasses, facial search engines, AI language tools and public databases to test surveillance capabilities. They found information including a person's home address, name and phone number — just by looking at them.

Fareed Kaviani is a research fellow at the Emerging Technologies Research Lab at Monash University. In 2024, he co-authored a paper examining social perceptions of smart glasses use in Australia.

summary.en: More Australian aerial firefighting pilots are spending the European summers helping local authorities battle wildfires.

body.en:
While most Australians in Europe are at the beach, NSW aerial firefighting pilot Alex Pay spends his long summer days at a Greek airbase, waiting for a call to action.

"When you get a fire call, you're gonna be airborne in 15 minutes," he told SBS News.

Once in the air, Pay can spend up to 10 hours supporting local authorities in Greece's fight against wildfires, which over the past week saw two pilots killed and hundreds of thousands forced to evacuate.

Pay, 31, works for a small but growing number of Australian private aerial firefighting companies based in Western Europe during this year's fire season, which is shaping up to be the continent's worst in record.

It also comes as Australia's own looming El Niño threatens to turn up the heat on our own summer bushfire risk .

Pay is a third-generation pilot with Pay's Air Service, which is based in the NSW Hunter Region.

"I remember as a kid flying with my dad to visit my grandparents," he told SBS News.

He pilots one of 14 aircraft his company has based throughout Greece for the summer. It’s his second season in the country, and the fifth overall for his company.

They fly a variant of the Air Tractor AT-802, nicknamed the "Fire Boss" — an amphibious aircraft that scoops water into a tank, or "hopper", controlled by a computerised fire gate that can be adjusted to match exact conditions.

In Australia, there were around 130 certified firefighting aeroplane operators or individual pilots, with a further 186 helicopter operators in 2021, according to Australia's Civil Aviation Authority.

Andrew Mackay is from Ballarat-based Field Air Group, which also has planes stationed in Greece this summer supporting Pay's.

"We like to say in our industry that it's not the aircraft that put out the fires, it's the ground crew — we're merely a tool to assist them," he told SBS News.

He said pilots will often work on either side of the fire to create a "triangle or an arrowhead, so the fire comes to a point where the ground crew can then extinguish that".

Sometimes they will drop water or retardant directly onto a house under threat from a blaze.

"We spent a lot of time training and preparing scenarios that give us a good education on what we might see on the fire ground," Pay said.

On Sunday, a Greek and a Danish national were killed after two helicopters collided while fighting a fire west of Athens.

The helicopters were leased from Australian company McDermott Aviation, which said in a statement it was "deeply saddened" by the tragedy.

title.en: Jetstar’s new overhead baggage rules explained: When they start and what you'll pay
title.zh: 捷星航空新随身行李规定解读：何时生效，费用几何

summary.en: Budget airline Jetstar is changing its carry-on baggage policy, moving from a weight-based limit to a new model based on size. This adjustment will affect when the new rules start and what passengers will be charged.
summary.zh: 廉价航空公司捷星航空将更改其随身行李政策，从基于重量的限制转向基于尺寸的新模式。这项调整将影响新规何时生效以及乘客需要支付的费用。

body.en:
Storing carry-on baggage in overhead lockers on Jetstar flights will cost up to $52 one-way, as the budget airline announces new charges for passengers.

Jetstar chief executive Stephanie Tully says the changes to the airline's carry-on baggage allowances will streamline boarding and help more flights depart on time.

"Our new carry-on baggage model provides more choice to customers while helping to keep our fares low," Tully added.

"You only pay for what you need — travelling with less means paying less, and you can always add more if you need."

The changes follow "extensive research and feedback from customers and crew" which found frustrations with weighing bags and finding enough room in overhead lockers, Jetstar said.

From 2 February, Jetstar will lift its 7kg carry-on weight limit in favour of a size-based carry-on baggage model.

Cabin baggage scales used to weigh passengers' carry-on bags before boarding will no longer be "routinely" used, the airline said.

Passengers will be able to bring one small bag to place under the seat, such as a backpack, handbag or laptop bag. That bag can weigh up to 10kg and be up to 40 x 30 x 20cm. Any bags larger than that will incur a fee.

Passengers who want to store a larger carry-on bag in overhead lockers will be charged between $25 and $52 one-way, depending on the flight route, for "limited" priority carry-on.

Jetstar said the fee for a one-way flight from Launceston to Sydney would start at $25, rising to $33 for a one-way flight between Sydney and Melbourne and $52 for a one-way flight between Cairns and Tokyo.

Priority boarding will be provided for passengers who pay for the carry-on option.

Ruby and her 11-year-old son Mark were dreading the day his scores on the national school assessment program were released.

And they confirmed the family's worst fears: despite working hard to learn, the Year 5 student remained behind his peers.

Mark, whose name the Australian Associated Press agreed not to publish, was one of more than 1.3 million children in Years 3, 5, 7, and 9 who sat the National Assessment Program — Literacy and Numeracy (NAPLAN) in 2026.

As the only standardised national assessment, NAPLAN was primarily designed to help governments and schools measure results and fix funding or teaching shortfalls.

"When I got the results, because it comes under Mark's name, he wanted to see his results,'' Ruby said.

"I just thought to myself, 'How could it be right at the bottom when he's improved so much?'"

But scores for reading were worse than in 2025 for every year level, and Year 5 students were the only cohort whose writing ability had improved.

Overall, about one in three students across all levels did not meet basic literacy and numeracy benchmarks, falling into "developing" and "needs additional support" categories.

The writing scores were a particular concern in the two lowest grades tested, with less than 10 per cent of students exceeding national benchmarks.

Numeracy results had improved for most cohorts since 2025, though Year 3's score had decreased.

Results from previous years showed a clear literacy divide between children from wealthy, educated areas and those who grow up in areas of low socio-economic status.

Ruby said she also struggled at school and her challenges went unnoticed because of her learning environment.

"With Mark, I just wish there was more people, just more at the school to help," she said.

Better support that understands the specific needs of struggling families would help improve results, The Smith Family chief executive Doug Taylor said.

"With 72,000 low-income students across Australia, the right support at the right time can make a huge difference," he said, noting schools should also consider the skills students had beyond academic ones.

In rural communities and towns with high Indigenous populations, results have dramatically improved in recent years.

That was due to increased funding and the use of explicit teaching models, Education Minister Jason Clare said in a speech at the Garma Indigenous festival over the weekend.

"Over the last four years, the numeracy results of Indigenous students have gone up and up,'' he said.

summary.en: Gender identity, sexuality and ancestry: Here's what's new in the 2026 Census.
